resonance.what: the cavity of the shell's whorls, open at the aperture
resonance.formula: f = (c / (2 * pi)) * sqrt(A / (V * L_eff)), L_eff = L + 1.7 * a (one flanged end)

parameters.aperture_area: from the model's aperture (asset.json coiling.aperture at the last whorl)
parameters.volume: the whorls' enclosed volume, from the model
parameters.neck_length: the aperture lip's thickness, about 1 mm at real size

resonance.dsp_approximation: a resonant band-pass at f, driven by whatever excites it (wind noise, later)
resonance.excited_by: nothing yet: the 'sea in a shell' needs wind (add-weather-and-dust-storm)
resonance.citation: Kinsler, Frey, Coppens and Sanders, Fundamentals of Acoustics, 4th ed., section 10.8 (Helmholtz resonator)

note: Emits nothing of its own; it is a find, collected with E. Its in-rack use (the Snail sequencer) makes no acoustic claim. Minimal placeholder until add-acoustic-asset-profiles defines the schema; that task upgrades this file. Lives beside asset.json, which tools/blender/create_snail_shell.py rewrites.
